summary: Alight, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a reverse stock split and related charter amendments approved by stockholders at its June 10, 2026 annual meeting. The reverse stock split is 1-for-20 for Class A common stock, Class B non-voting common stock, and Class V common stock, effective June 29, 2026. A corresponding 1-for-20 reverse unit split of Alight Units in a subsidiary was also executed. The charter amendments also included board declassification and officer exculpation under DGCL Section 102(b)(7). This is an ordinary corporate action with no special situation dynamics; no deal consideration, premium, or stakeholder contest is involved. Watch for any subsequent stock price adjustment to the reverse split.
